caption: Piazza della Signoria, Florence
composition: Palazzo Vecchio and Loggia dei Lanzi · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The square is empty at dawn. The crenellated bulk of Palazzo Vecchio with its tall tower occupies the left, while the open arches of the Loggia dei Lanzi run along the right, its statues standing dark under the vaults. Soft 07:22 morning light washes the stone warm, and the long shadows of the paving stretch across the foreground. The white marble lion on its pedestal at the far right closes the frame.
